==Concepts==
*jvajvo - a lujvo that can be unwrapped into a bridi according to rules of its consisting slotted rafsi.
*cimjvo - a lujvo the meaning (+ sometimes place structure) of which is unpredictable from its constituent rafsi
*lujvo -a verb formally consisting of rafsi according to Lojban morphology.
==jvajvo classes==
If for a given lujvo you find more places than listed here it means this lujvo is not a jvajvo.

Slotted rafsi:
# -gau suffix. '''x1 x2 x3 x4 ... brodygau''' unwraps into '''x1 gasnu lo nu x2 broda x3 x4 ...'''. Equivalent to '''x1 jai gau broda fai x2 x3 x4 ...'''
# -ske suffix. '''brodyske''' = ''x1 is the broda science, broda-ology studying particular subject x2''
# -pre suffix. '''brodypre''' means ''x1 is a brodaman, a broda-er''. Roughly corresponds to English "-er" or "-man" like "fireman" etc. Can describe only persons, not non-conscious pbjects.
# '''cmacma''', '''brabra''' mean ''very small'', ''very big''. Unwrap according to [[la tsani|La Tsani]]'s Flipping Principle.
# '''tce-''' prefix. '''tcebroda''' unwraps into '''mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
==False friends==
# '''bra-''' prefix generates cimjvo. '''bramlatu''' is ''Big Cat'', not ''big cat''. '''braxamsi''' is described by some not just as a ''big xamsi'' but having some new properties.
# '''cma-''' prefix generates cimjvo.
